title: Operating Lines of Credit Relationship Discount Scaled to Farm Real Estate Borrowing
content:
The relationship discount granted on an Operating Lines of Credit line on the AutoDraft enrolment day is scaled to the principal balance of the member's farmland mortgage with the association, as the member's Farm Real Estate Loans records show it.

## Rule

The relationship discount is:

- **the product's relationship discount multiplied by the principal balance of the member's Farm Real Estate loan in active status divided by the line's commitment, rounded to 3 decimal places**, when that balance is below the commitment;
- **1.5 times the product's relationship discount** when that balance is at least 2.0 times the commitment;
- **the product's relationship discount** when the balance is at least the commitment but below 2.0 times it;
- **zero** when the member holds no Farm Real Estate loan in active status.

The relationship discount so set is one of the rate discounts that are added together and capped at the product's discount cap.

## Discount by product (percentage points)

| Product | Product relationship discount | Balance at least 2.0 times the commitment | Balance from the commitment up to but not including 2.0 times it |
|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 0.10 (0.1) | 0.15 | 0.10 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 0.10 (0.1) | 0.15 | 0.10 |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 0.10 (0.1) | 0.15 | 0.10 |
| Revolving Operating Line | 0.15 | 0.225 | 0.15 |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 0.15 | 0.225 | 0.15 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical Revolving Operating Line, commitment USD 400,000)

| Farm Real Estate loan in active status, principal balance | Relationship discount |
|---|---|
| USD 250,000 | 0.15 multiplied by 250,000 and divided by 400,000, that is 0.09375, rounded to 0.094 |
| USD 400,000 | 0.15 — the balance equals the commitment |
| USD 799,999 | 0.15 |
| USD 800,000 | 0.225 — the balance is 2.0 times the commitment |
| No active Farm Real Estate loan | 0 |
